arguments.explanation: Flags online transactions whose amount is over $2,000.
assumptions: 'Over $2,000' is read as strictly greater than $2,000 (amount_usd_cents > 200000), so exactly $2,000.00 is not flagged.
Amounts are in integer US cents, so $2,000 is 200000.
Negative amounts are not flagged, since they fall below the threshold.
